leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a basic message queue system with producer and consumer components
Configure event-driven communication between decoupled services
Implement message persistence and delivery guarantees in a queue
Apply publish-subscribe patterns to broadcast events to multiple consumers
Manipulate queue parameters to control message throughput and latency
Integrate a message broker to handle service-to-service communication
Initialize and monitor queue health and performance metrics
